description: This file defines the main application component for a React-based frontend. It includes a custom hook to detect viewport size, a desktop-only overlay component, and the main App component that conditionally renders either the overlay or the application routes based on screen width.

methods.name: useIsBelowDesktopBreakpoint
methods.description: Custom React hook that detects if the current viewport width is below a specified breakpoint (default 1024px). It listens to window resize events and updates reactively.

methods.name: DesktopOnlyOverlay
methods.description: React functional component that renders an overlay informing users that the application is only available on desktop devices.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main application component that renders either the DesktopOnlyOverlay or the AppRoutes component based on viewport size.
